C1102.title: Police Crack 79 AI Face-Swapping Fraud Cases
C1102.summary: The Ministry of Public Security reported that police launched a special operation targeting AI face-swapping fraud, solving 79 related cases and arresting 515 suspects. Criminals primarily used photos as material for AI face-swapping to carry out scams.
